subject: Request to keep demo environment live while PO routes
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@clearframe.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@clearframe.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo environment — PO in flight, can we avoid expiry?

Hi Rishi,

Quick update from our side: finance has routed the PO for Redwood but it’s currently blocked in our vendor onboarding queue because Legal needs a signed vendor form and our procurement team flagged a short SOC 2 evidence gap. Tom and I expect the paperwork to clear in ~5–7 business days, but the sandbox tokens and the demo workspace are set to expire on Friday.

Is there anything Redwood can do to keep the demo live while our internal process completes? We’ve got two product managers scheduled to test the integration next week and would hate to lose momentum.

I’ve attached the vendor intake form procurement asked us to complete (procurement@clearframe.com asked that we submit it back to them once we have Redwood’s proof-of-service).

Thanks — really appreciate any help you can offer,
Emily
Emily Zhao
Senior Product Manager, ClearFrame Health
emily.zhao@clearframe.com
+1 415-555-0182

Attachments:
- ClearFrame_Vendor_Form.pdf (pdf)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@clearframe.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo environment — PO in flight, can we avoid expiry?

Hi Emily — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the form.

Short answer: yes. We don’t want you to lose momentum. Two options I can do today:

1) Apply a 7-day preservation extension to the demo environment (keeps current tokens and workspace live)
2) Or apply a temporary credit allocation (up to 250k token-equivalent) to let your engineers run heavier tests while PO desks work through onboarding and SOC 2 evidence exchange

Before I finalize, two quick asks:
- Can procurement confirm the exact vendor form fields they need Redwood to complete? (I’ll loop in our compliance team)
- Which of the two options do you prefer? If it’s the temporary credit, I’ll request approval from my manager and confirm in writing.

Cc’ing Priyom (AM) and Grace (CS) so they’re aware and can help with the technical handoff if we keep the demo live.

I’ll hold off until I hear back from procurement or you.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
From: procurement@clearframe.com <procurement@clearframe.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@clearframe.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo environment — PO in flight, can we avoid expiry?

Hi all,

We received the preliminary vendor form. For Redwood to proceed in our system we need:
- Completed vendor intake (the file Emily attached) with Redwood’s primary billing address
- Signed copy of standard terms (or confirmation of acceptance by email)
- Current SOC 2 Type II attestation (or evidence of an active remediation plan + timeline)

Estimated time to complete once we have documents: 3–5 business days. If Redwood can provide the SOC 2 report and sign the intake form today, we can accelerate to 48–72 hours.

Regards,
Claudia Perez
Procurement Operations, ClearFrame
procurement@clearframe.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Demo environment — PO in flight, can we avoid expiry?

Rishi / Grace —

I’ll own approvals on the credit side. Quick internal check: our standard short-term bridge is either "environment pause" for up to 7 days or a temporary credit grant (approved by AM + Sales Manager) of up to 250k tokens for this type of procurement lag. If the customer needs more than that we escalate.

Grace — can you confirm that pausing the demo will preserve the existing KV cache and webhook configs so their integration tests won’t require re-setup? If yes, pausing is lowest-friction. If not, we should go with the temporary credit.

I’ll prepare the internal approval note if Emily requests the credit.

—Priyom
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@clearframe.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo environment — PO in flight, can we avoid expiry?

Emily / team —

If you choose the environment pause we’ll preserve KV caches, routes, and webhook bindings for the 7-day extension. Your tokens will not be consumed while paused but the environment remains configured and can be resumed with no re-setup. The only thing that won’t be preserved is ephemeral session logs older than 30 days (not relevant for this demo).

If you need to run heavy load tests while procurement completes, choose the temporary credit. I recommend the pause unless you plan to stress the integration next week.

Emily — which do you want? If pause, I’ll apply it now. If credit, Priyom will route approval and I’ll provision it once we have signoff.

Thanks,
Grace
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@clearframe.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, procurement@clearframe.com
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 07:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo environment — PO in flight, can we avoid expiry?

Thanks, team — appreciate the quick coordination.

We’ll take the 7-day environment pause. We do not need heavy load testing this week; product managers just need to walk through flows and confirm API mappings. Please apply the pause today so we can keep next week’s meetings intact.

Procurement: I’ll push Redwood’s vendor form to you once I have the signed copy from Rishi.

Emily

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
